caveat: demo: 99 subjects — every number below is noise; this run checks that every stage executes on real MIMIC-IV data

infoflow.note: flagged = recovers a treatment state (ventilation / vasopressor) from one physiology channel alone; orders_begun is reported, never flagged

tuning.note: dev subjects only; the winner's dev AUROC is optimistic by selection

ideal_circumstances.meaning: every input, including the culture / antibiotic orders that make up half of the label; hourly AUROC over every stay, sepsis present on arrival included

primary.meaning: physiology only (no treatments, no orders); hourly AUROC, early-warning cohort (onset >= 4 h) — the pre-registered primary setting

absolute_auroc_gt_0.80.reason: futile: at the dev estimate 0.636 the lock (SE 0.142) confirms AUROC > 0.8 with probability 0.00 < 0.8

stack_over_direct_by_0.01.reason: underpowered: the lock's minimum detectable difference is 0.191 (SE 0.077, 20 subjects); a claimed difference of 0.01 cannot be confirmed
